Owner Verification Step 1 of 4 Confirm your identity To start hosting your space on ParkShare, we need to verify your credentials for security and trust. Identification Details PAN Number Enter your 10-digit Permanent Account Number Upload Documents Citizenship (Front) Citizenship (Back) Driving License Tap to upload or take photo Selfie Verification Take Photo I confirm that all provided information is accurate and I agree to the verification terms. Save Draft Continue
Step 2 of 4 Legal & Location Verify your property ownership to start listing your space on ParkShare. Ownership Certificate (Lalpurja) Latest Property Tax Receipt Must be from current fiscal year Set Property Location Upload Lalpurja Upload Tax Receipt JPG, PNG or PDF (Max 5MB) Dragging the pin precisely to your property entrance helps drivers find you easier. Verification Tip Ensure the name on your Lalpurja matches the Citizenship ID provided in Step 1.
Step 3 of 4 Security Verification To verify your parking space, please upload clear photos of the entry points and safety equipment. This helps users feel secure when booking. Entry Gate Includes the entry mechanism or street entrance clearly. Front View Back View Left View Right View CCTV View Safety Gear Owner Photo A selfie in the location for physical access. Privacy & Security Your photos are stored on secured servers and only used for internal verification purposes. Continue to Final Step
